visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of linked image tiles (him/her, collections, brands)
visualCharacteristics.summary: Image-only linked tiles in an even grid (2 or 4 columns)
visualCharacteristics.layout: Even grid; columns follow the tile count (2 tiles = 2 columns, 3/6/9 = 3 columns, otherwise 4); 2 columns on mobile; images keep their natural aspect ratio

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: tile image; cell 2 (optional): label and/or link. One link makes the whole tile clickable
contentPattern.source: 2 linked image tiles (Watches for him, Watches for her) | 8 linked collection image tiles (Raga Glimmers, Edge Fumage, Raga Memoirs, Stellar, Cocktails, Automatic, Raga Silvers, Titan Women) | 12 linked brand image tiles (Titan, Fastrack, Sonata, Tommy Hilfiger, Kenneth Cole, Police, Ducati, Zoop, Raga, Xylys, Edge, Nebula)

usage: Collection, brand or audience entry points where every tile should be visible.
reuseGuidance: Use for static grids. If tiles should scroll horizontally use carousel-tiles; for a featured large tile use cards-bento.
